entity.summary: Open-source self-custody Bitcoin wallet ecosystem distributed primarily through mobile applications, with a separately distributed desktop wallet.
entity.notes: The project describes its origin in the 2017 Bitcoin bull-run/fork-war period. Hosted lndhub.io Lightning service history is tracked as a service event rather than a wallet shutdown.

products.summary: BlueWallet mobile Bitcoin wallet for iOS and Android with user-controlled keys.
products.notes: First-party BlueWallet source history shows the mobile app in a store-versioned release lineage during 2018, including store version 1.2.0 with iOS bundle/build metadata on 2018-05-12. WLR records year precision only because the reviewed history does not establish a defensible exact initial public-release day.

products.summary: Separately distributed BlueWallet desktop application; current first-party material directly documents the macOS build.
products.notes: BlueWallet's first-party 2020-08-28 article announces that BlueWallet for Desktop was out on the Mac Store and explicitly calls it the team's first desktop product. WLR therefore records the public desktop launch at day precision on 2020-08-28. The reviewed launch source establishes macOS availability only; earlier implementation work is not used to backdate the public launch.

events.title: BlueWallet hosted lndhub.io Lightning service shut down
events.description: BlueWallet sunset its hosted lndhub.io Lightning service, ending new wallet creation and refill support before the May 31, 2023 shutdown while leaving regular Bitcoin wallets unaffected.
events.notes: BlueWallet continued to support self-hosted LndHub and its self-custody Bitcoin wallet; this event does not represent a BlueWallet shutdown.

events.title: BlueWallet v7.0.9 fixed preferred Electrum server persistence
events.description: BlueWallet v7.0.9 fixed the preferred Electrum server persistence issue tracked as #7532, where a saved custom preferred server could be replaced by a suggested server after app restarts on the documented iOS reproductions.
events.notes: This is recorded as a software fix, not a vulnerability or exploit. WLR scopes the event only to BlueWallet Mobile because the reviewed reproductions are iOS/mobile; Desktop impact, server compromise, an affected pre-fix version range, and fund loss are not inferred.

events.title: BlueWallet Mobile released by 2018
events.description: BlueWallet's official source history records a store-versioned mobile build during 2018, establishing the mobile product as released by that year.
events.notes: Year precision only. The reviewed source history establishes a store/release lineage in 2018 but does not establish a defensible exact initial public-release day.

events.title: BlueWallet Desktop released for macOS
events.description: BlueWallet announced that its first desktop product was out on the Mac Store on 2020-08-28.
events.notes: The first-party article directly states current Mac Store availability and identifies this as BlueWallet’s first desktop product, supporting day precision. No earlier source-code preparation is used to backdate launch.
